meta: Every home needs its own listing, and agents often spend a whole evening writing them. AI writes listings from real specs and comparison tables, as long as nothing is made up.

muc.title: Writing property listings
muc.text: Every home needs its own listing, and agents often spend a whole evening just writing them.

muc.title: Write from real specs
muc.text: Give AI the floor area, number of rooms, which way the house faces, and the distance to schools and markets, and ask for a clear listing with no exaggeration.

muc.title: Edit photos, don't mislead
muc.text: AI can brighten photos and remove clutter, but don't add windows or gardens that don't exist, or buyers who come to see it will lose trust.

muc.title: A comparison table for buyers
muc.text: Ask AI for a table comparing a few homes for a buyer, like price per square meter, commute time, pros and cons, then check every number yourself.

muc.title: A 150-word listing
muc.text: Take a home you're selling, give AI the real specs, ask for a listing under 150 words, then check every detail.
